description: Train a low-rank adapter on the tiny CPU Llama to say each training prompt's counterfactual answer: a rank-4 LoRA at layer 0's output (`alpha` 8, so its update is scaled by 2), applied at every position of the prompt after BOS (`{'index': '1:'}`: position 0 is BOS) as a write (`apply` keeps the site's layout, so the whole sequence is written), and the cross entropy of the head's logits at the last position against `train.cf_answer`. `B` starts at zero, so before the first step the adapted model is the model exactly. After training, the body runs on the held-out split (`fit.held_out.ce`) and on the training split (`fit.train.ce`); `fit.history.ce` is the training ce after each epoch. The adapter is saved as a bundle, `fit.lora` (lora_apply.json loads it). The model is random, so this demonstrates the mechanics and nothing about what an adapter learns.
